evidence_status_basis.rationale: The creator-described precedent is relevant but does not establish learning effectiveness.

request_interpretation: Explore one author-reviewable educational interactive-fiction direction.

design_directions.title: Consequential ecological choices
design_directions.concept: Use visible consequences to support reflection without claiming measured outcomes.

intended_audience.value: To be decided by the author

design_directions.interaction_mechanism: Players choose among actions and inspect their consequences.
design_directions.educational_relationship: The consequences create prompts for reflection and discussion.

knowledge_support.use: Provides a creator-described precedent for choices in an environmental learning context.

applicability_conditions: The design can expose consequences without presenting one interpretation as correct.
transfer_assumptions: The precedent can transfer to the proposed topic.
risks: The educational relationship may remain too implicit.

limitations: Creator descriptions do not demonstrate learning effectiveness.
follow_up_questions: Which audience and setting should anchor the next pass?
